title: Day (moving sun)
description: A running day: the sun moves from morning to evening, near-white so grey cobbles stay grey-brown and grass stays green at noon, a clear blue sky and a light cool haze. The preset for a world with a clock; warm the look with sky, surfaces and lamps, not with the sun.
